findings: 测试过即局部completed，仍缺最终HEAD、独立必需case、禁止改tests/diffscope、真实目标核验。

practices: 为什么复制trustedrepo不sandbox测试？测试import/顶层仍可访问宿主文件/网络/秘密/进程；路径限制和固定argv不替代OS隔离。
他人在planner提案后先修了文件怎么办？重核原摘要/版本并在commit点CAS，old为0/多处拒；原子rename不解决并发前提。
为什么打印Ran999不能当测试数？使用finalrunner摘要与exit/正数/no-skip，本地同进程输出仍非抗任意恶意测试的证明。
接入模型怎样不削弱合同？模型只供typedaction，保callerroot/patch前提/预算/真实执行边界/最终独立receipt；当前不接模型。

Feed a recorded external finding through the CLI against a changed source snapshot. It must fail the same quote gate as local reviewers.

Raise quorum from 2 to3 on the sample. Identify which true finding becomes needs-review and which false positive was already a singleton.
practice_groups.chinese_answer_or_criteria: quorum2改3：eval三票仍通过，TLS两票转待审并保分歧，comment一直singleton；不能把待审当false。

practice_groups.original_practice_section:
## Investigate the failure boundary

Implement a reviewer that ignores AbortSignal. Show that the runner can stop waiting but cannot guarantee the external work stopped.
practice_groups.chinese_answer_or_criteria: 忽略AbortSignal的回调可能在runner不再等待后继续，实际停止/效果/usage另核；本次不运行回调。

practice_groups.original_practice_section:
## Investigate the failure boundary

Hold out a case found by only one reviewer. Measure whether quorum loses that true positive before presenting agreement as an improvement.

Local reviewers are distinct static heuristics, not independent LLMs. Consensus measures support, not truth. External callbacks must honor AbortSignal; timeout cannot undo a remote side effect.

projects.problem: 固定Git证据、保body/migration/revert、稳定MD与来源收据；本地草稿不等发布或迁移真实性。
stage_intents: ParseLog只firsttab/hash7..40lowerhex/subject/dup；fullNUL三元组另保多行body，不按body换行切commit
type(scope)!:description窄grammar，未知非空Other，incomingBreaking与!OR以保footer风险
breaking先feat/fix/other，新组slice按hash排序不改原input，revert和target不净掉
label/budget先校，固定section与Markdown转义/sourcehash；realrepo resolve40/from..to，附migration/revert与rawSHA
code_walk: ParseGitExport4MiB/NUL三字段/末界/dup，migration两拼法与非空连续行，explicit40revertregex。footercollector可能覆盖多段/吞入Refs，空footer风险未知。
gitRead argv/no-pager/ReadRepository单ctx10s包括2resolve+log、4MiBstdout/stderr丢弃，ref用end-of-options和commit解析，支持SHA1不是SHA256。
Group/Release公开入口未复查hash/dup，Hash直接渲染；安全性依赖先ParseLog。主分组排序不保证Snapshot附加migration清单换序同bytes。
CLIinput先全read再4MiBparse，output/receipt任意且非atomicpair/可同路径覆盖；来源hash不绑定渲染器/label/最终产物/批准，Rawbody可能含敏感资料。
findings: shorthex格式不证明真实Git对象，realrepo resolver才40位；export..export只是输入模式。
迁移footer仅作者声明，revert保留供最终行为核，不自动推断影响已抵销。
25defs，realreadonlyrange测试会临时init/add/commit，全部仅静读未运行。
practices: body能多行，NUL三元组完整末界必须保，截断拒，source与SHA保不partial导入。
同标题incomingfalse/true，无!时后者仍True，有!都True；OR不丢footer。
shuffle主组稳定，附加清单也固定才能宣全bytes稳定；revert/target保最终行为审。
